sloka: ये तु पूर्वं महात्मानः कुम्भकर्णेन पातिताः।ते स्वस्था वानरश्रेष्ठाः सुग्रीवमुपतस्थिरे ।। ६.६९.८१ ।।
transliteration: ye tu pūrvaṁ mahātmānaḥ kumbhakarṇena pātitāḥ।te svasthā vānaraśreṣṭhāḥ sugrīvamupatasthire ।। 6.69.81 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras seeing (Naranthaka advancing) spoke to his son Angada who resembled Indra in valour.
